name: Captain Planet Creative Machine
laws: Only one heavyweight specialist may hold a lease at a time.
A candidate is never presented as installed.
An artifact scaffold is not runtime proof.
Unknown or over-budget memory is denied.
Long media is a continuity-controlled sequence, not one unverified generation.
Every route must produce a command and a receipt.
A model name is not a capability until a local artifact passes its bakeoff.
Technical artifact quality proves bounded media integrity, not perceptual or studio quality.
Installed artifact proof requires a fresh Codexa inventory and independent local decode.
A planning memory estimate cannot authorize activation without a measured peak-memory receipt.
